name: b6675-well-d
prompt: Vertical 9:16 photoreal cinematic, an old round stone-lined well in a desert oasis at sunrise. Over the well, two upright wooden posts carry a horizontal beam with a simple wooden PULLEY WHEEL. A WOODEN bucket bound with dark bands, with a curved rope handle across its top, rests upright on the well's dry stone rim, filled to just below the brim with calm clear water. The palm-fibre rope comes down from the pulley in one straight taut line and is TIED to the middle of the bucket's handle - one continuous rope from pulley to bucket. NO loops, NO nooses, NO hanging rings, NO loose ends; no water spilling, the rim and stones dry. Date palms and green shrubs behind, bright blue sky, soft golden light. No people, no hands, no animals, no text, no modern objects.
